title: Legal Notice (General)
description: A formal legal notice demanding that the other party do something (pay money, return a deposit, stop an action, compensate) within a fixed time before you take legal action.
forum: Sent directly to the other party
law: General civil and criminal law; prerequisite to many suits and complaints

fields.name: subject
fields.label: Notice regarding
fields.placeholder: e.g. refund of security deposit of Rs. 40,000

fields.name: legal_provisions
fields.label: Relevant provisions (optional)
fields.help: Filled in automatically when you come from the Law Matcher.

fields.name: demand
fields.label: What do you want the recipient to do?
fields.placeholder: e.g. refund the security deposit of Rs. 40,000 with interest at 9% per annum

fields.name: consequence
fields.label: Action you will take if they do not comply
options: initiate appropriate civil and/or criminal proceedings against you
file a complaint before the appropriate Consumer Commission
file a suit for recovery of the amount with interest and costs
file a complaint before the appropriate authority and court

document.heading: LEGAL NOTICE
document.mode_of_delivery: By Registered Post A.D. / Speed Post / Email
document.subject: Legal notice regarding {subject}
intro: I, {sender_name}, residing at {sender_address}, hereby serve upon you the following legal notice:

paragraphs.text: Your acts and omissions are in violation of law, including: {legal_provisions}.

paragraphs: Despite my requests, you have failed to resolve the matter, which has caused me financial loss, inconvenience and mental harassment.
I therefore call upon you to {demand} within {compliance_days} days of receipt of this notice.
Take notice that if you fail to comply within the said period, I shall be constrained to {consequence}, entirely at your risk as to costs and consequences, without any further notice to you.
A copy of this notice has been retained for record and further action.
